StatusConditionDescriptions.Berserk: Can't take the Cast Action or Focus, it can’t be Frightened, and it doesn’t make Morale Checks.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Burning: A die roll indicates damage it takes at the start of its turns, unless an appropriate action is taken to end it (such as dousing fire).
StatusConditionDescriptions.Charmed: It can't willingly attack the charmer.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Confused: Its Checks and SAves have Hinder, and Saves against its Actions have Favor.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Dazed: It can't Focus or Move unless it uses an Action to do so.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Fatigued: Fatigue is measured from 0 to 5 with the following rules: - Each Fatigue occupies an Item Slot. - At 3 or ore Fatigue, it can't Rush. - At 5 Fatigue, it dies.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Frightened: It has a -2 penalty to damage it deals.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Incapacitated: It can't Focus or use its Actions or Move, fails all Might and Dexterity Checks, and is Vulnerable.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Invisible: It can't be seen by normal senses, and thos that can't see it act as Blinded for Checks and Saves involving it.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Paralyzed: It is Incapacitated and its Speed is 0.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Prone: You can either drop or stand from Prone by using 10' of Speed. While Prone: Speed cost is halved, it cannot Rush, and is Vulnerable for the purposes of Melee Attacks and Dodge Checks.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Restrained: It is Vulnerable and its Speed is 0.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Sickened: It has a -2 penalty to any healing it receives. Additional effects may be indicated by the cause of the Sickness.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Suffocating: Beings begin Suffocating after not breathing for 1 Minute. Heroes: Each Round, while Suffocating, roll a d8. If the result is equal to or greater than your Might, gain 1 Fatigue. Enemies: Each Round, while Suffocating, gain 1 Fatigue.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Unconscious: It is Blinded, Incapacitated, and Prone. Close Attacks Targeting it always Crit.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Vulnerable: Its attacks and Saves against attacks have Hinder. Attacks targeting it and Saves against its attacks have Favor.
StatusConditionDescriptions.Grappling: Physically causing a Target to be Restrained by using your body is Grappling. A Being that is physically restraining a Target has its Speed halved, unless the Target is smaller.
